title: Wright Brothers' Flight (NARA 16-P-1316-1, NAID 2038)
maker: U.S. Department of Agriculture motion picture unit (Record Group 16)
nara_description: This film documents the official test flight of the Wright Brothers' military airplane at Fort Myer, Virginia, on July 27, 1909.
licence: Public domain in the US: a work of the US federal government made by its employees on duty (17 U.S.C. § 105). The footage itself was shot in 1909. Korea: films are protected for 70 years from publication, long expired.
